faqs.question: Where is Aurora Beauty Lounge located in Dubai?

faqs.question: What beauty services does Aurora Beauty Lounge offer in Dubai?
faqs.answer: We offer a full range of luxury beauty services including hair styling, manicure and pedicure, VIP facials, spa massage, eyebrow lamination, and classic and volume lash extensions. Every treatment is performed by experienced specialists using premium products.

faqs.question: Is Aurora a luxury beauty salon in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. Aurora Beauty Lounge is designed as a luxury beauty lounge in Dubai, offering refined treatments for hair, nails, skin, brows and lashes in an elegant salon environment at Azizi Riviera, Meydan.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment at Aurora Beauty Lounge?
faqs.answer: You can book online at https://www.aurorasalon.info/booking, call +971 503181009, or message us on WhatsApp. Choose your treatment, select a time slot, and confirm your visit to our Azizi Riviera salon in minutes.

faqs.question: Does Aurora Beauty Lounge serve clients from all over Dubai?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. While our salon is based in Azizi Riviera, Meydan, we welcome clients from Dubai Marina, Downtown, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, Mirdif and neighbourhoods across the city.

faqs.question: What are Aurora Beauty Lounge opening hours in Dubai?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM, and Sunday, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Book in advance to secure your preferred time at our Azizi Riviera beauty salon.
